atoms.b: The pharaohs ruled in ancient Egypt. They alone had power over the ((++people animal_kingdom)).
“Pharaoh” means something similar to “big house” and references the ((++royal_palaces skyscrapers)) they lived in.
The majority of ((++pharaohs goddesses)) were men, but there were some notable female pharaohs too. Famous examples include Hatshepsut and Cleopatra.

instruction.text: Select the pharaoh from these historical leaders.
Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: The pharaoh was a priest, warlord and judge all at the same time. The pharaoh decided the laws that controlled people’s lives and was responsible for war or peace.
Pharaohs were believed to be the masters of the entire land, including everything that grew and lived on it. Therefore, the farmers had to give a large part of their harvest to the pharaoh.

atoms.a: What were two of the pharaoh’s duties?
Why did the farmers have to give part of their harvest to the pharaoh?
b: The pharaoh couldn’t help with farming.
The pharaoh had a large family to look after.
++The whole kingdom belonged to the pharaoh.
